title: pouteria gutta
intro: Pouteria gutta, commonly known as the West African walnut, is a species of tree in the family Sapotaceae. It is valued for its timber and has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pouteria gutta include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria gutta include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
